'''Smelting Core D''' was the smelting area where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was deposited after being lost by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], at the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
